product_summary: Fine and speciality chemicals manufacturer (Pune, Maharashtra; CIN L24114PN2003PLC018532 per company website). Real product lines from own catalogue (cleanscience.co.in/products): Antioxidants/polymer stabilisers - BHT (CAS 128-37-0), BHA (25013-16-5), TBHQ (1948-33-0), Di-TBHQ (88-58-4), Clean AntiOX 962, Ascorbyl palmitate (137-66-6); Polymerisation inhibitors - Hydroquinone (123-31-9), MEHQ (150-76-5), TBC (98-29-3), 4-Hydroxy TEMPO (2226-96-2), 4-Oxo TEMPO (2896-70-0), 4-Butoxy TEMPO (154186-23-9); Aroma/agro/API intermediates - Anisole (100-66-3), Guaiacol (90-05-1), Veratrole (91-16-7), Catechol (120-80-9), 1,4-dimethoxybenzene (150-78-7), o-methoxy toluene (578-58-5), Mesityl oxide (141-79-7), 4-MAP (100-06-1), Barbituric acid (67-52-7), DCC (538-75-0); HALS light stabilisers - Clean Light Stab 770/944/622/119/783/2020, TMP (2403-88-5), TAA (826-36-8), HETMP, HMBTAD; Water treatment monomers - ATBS (15214-89-8), NaATBS; Dimethyl sebacate (106-79-6); construction/textile auxiliaries CLEAN PLAST, CLEAN SAP, CLEAN CAP.
comment: Declared codes are only partially representative. 290722 (hydroquinone and its salts) is correct but narrow: the company's hydroquinone line is largely sold as MEHQ/guaiacol/veratrole ethers (290950) and as TEMPO derivatives (293339), and HQ itself is one of many products. 293339 (pyridine-ring heterocyclics) is correct for the TEMPO/HALS/piperidinol family, which is a genuine and significant line. However the declaration omits the bulk of the portfolio: aromatic ethers (290930 - anisole, 4-MAP), other polyphenols/monophenols (290729, 290719 - BHT, BHA, TBHQ, catechol, TBC), dimethyl sebacate and ascorbyl palmitate (291829), mesityl oxide (291419), DCC (292519), barbituric acid (293354/293359), ATBS (292419) and formulated blends (382499). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification: this is a speciality/fine organic chemicals maker serving antioxidants, polymers, pharma/agro intermediates, food-feed additives and personal care - not oil & gas. No trader signs: own plants, in-house R&D and in-house catalytic processes are stated on the site, consistent with a manufacturer role. All product names/CAS numbers above are taken from the company's own product page; no customs line was available in this task, so the specific export HS lines actually used remain 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - the mapping is a technical classification of the catalogue, not evidence of shipments. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, codes corrected to the factual range above.
